name: Pentacon Six
note: 1966 is the introduction of the camera NAMED Pentacon Six (announced Photokina 1965; renamed Praktisix IIA to match the 1964 VEB Pentacon company rename). The 1960 the corpus carried belongs to the Praktisix era. Hanimex Praktica 66 is the export badge of this exact camera.

name: Pentina
note: The Pentina line uses its own proprietary breech-lock bayonet, incompatible with everything — the corpus said M42, which is wrong (camera-wiki, Eckman). Metering is selenium match-needle, not aperture-priority AE. 'Pentina I' is a phantom first-generation name that never shipped.

name: Praktisix
note: The Praktisix breech-lock bayonet IS the mount later called Pentacon Six / P6 — record it under the canonical display name so the whole system indexes on one mount.

name: Exakta 66
note: The 1984/86 Exakta 66 reissue (this row: year_introduced 1986) is a West German rework of the Pentacon Six and takes the Pentacon Six breech-lock bayonet — NOT the classic Ihagee Exakta 35mm bayonet the corpus claimed. Manufacturer is Exakta GmbH, Nuremberg (Mandermann/Schneider), not Ihagee Dresden.

name: Pentona
note: Developed by VEB Zeiss Ikon Dresden, produced by KW Niedersedlitz from 1956; 'Pentona I' folds in via the dedup file.

name: Praktica super TL
note: Hanimex-distributed export badge seen on real inventory (live fleet C0076).

name: Praktica LTL
note: M42 interchangeable-mount SLR; the fixed_lens object rode in from the maker-prefixed duplicate's scrape (kit lens read as fixed). Gate mount_and_fixed_lens caught it.

name: Praktica VLC 3
note: M42 interchangeable-mount SLR (interchangeable-finder VLC line); fixed_lens is a kit-lens scraping artifact from the folded maker-prefixed row. Gate mount_and_fixed_lens caught it.

name: Penti I
note: The folded maker-prefixed scrape row said point-and-shoot and its value survived the merge; the Penti I is a 1963 manual scale-focus viewfinder half-frame.

name: Pentina
note: Interchangeable Pentina bayonet; the standard CZJ Tessar 50/2.8 was scraped as a fixed lens. Surfaced by the gate once the pentina mount family resolved.

name: Pentina FM
note: Interchangeable Pentina bayonet; standard-lens scrape artifact, as on the base Pentina row.
